hebrew: אִם מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאִם עַל הַמֶּלֶךְ טוֹב תִּנָּתֶן לִי נַפְשִׁי בִּשְׁאֵלָתִי וְעַמִּי בְּבַקָּשָׁתִי
translation: If I have found favor in your eyes, O king, and if it pleases the king, may my life be given me in my petition and my people in my request.
information:
Purim song

Ester 7:3

אסתר ז ג

The Midrash states that in all those areas in Megillas Ester that it says Hamelech without mentioning Achashveirosh, it refers also to Hashem.
